Unit 12 — Season 2

After the exam, the games keep coming: the grid/symmetry jam, then two placeholder flex days whose topic arrives with the season — closing the year with the same ritual it began with: pitch, build, playtest, ship, retro.

Concepts this unit owns

The grid is a list of lists (Unit 10's data structure, two-dimensional) and the year's last word on constraints. The final retro — pattern inventory, September letter — is the course's real final exam. CED: AAP-3, CRD-1, IOC-1.
